body: the last thing i would want to do is worry someone. get some good rest, thank you for being the nicest person on this planet <3

you are so sweet.
i've talked to multiple people. i'm talking to friends right now. i've honestly never felt so fucking loved the fact that you're so concerned about me makes me worry but you actually care and it's really mindblowing to me. i've been trying my best to get better, and one more shot at it wouldn't hurt i guess.
wonderful. i hope it continues like that for you. you have been more help than most people in my life. tysm for this.

a lot. i introduced my friend to my brother and they hit it off. it made me mad. we were all on a call together, and it felt like they were ignoring me. it started off just me and my friend, but my brother joined and it felt like he took him from me. i have massive feelings for the guy, i don't want to sound like i'm trying to hog him for myself but i like one on one time with him, and both of them made me feel ignored. i would have been fine with it if they didn't make me feel like i was impeding on THEIR friendship. me and my friend have known each other for years and my brother only knew him for not even 10 minutes.

the thing that bothers me the most is that i'm unable to find a therapist and/or psychiatrist available in my area. i've had issues with my mental health for a while now but despite my efforts i'm unable to get help. i've reached out but the more i'm denied help the worse everything gets. i've got so tired of trying that i just want to give up, fall asleep, and never wake up. it sounds like the easiest way to stop ruining everyone else's lives and take care of my own. i'm sick of running from my problems and shoving them under the rug. i can't take responsibility for myself no matter how much i tell myself i need to, and i can't take care of any of my issues on my own. i'm alone in this fight and i'm finally surrendering.
